# Measured weights for the internal/testing/e2e catch-all shards
# (test-e2e-other.yml), in seconds.
#
# `TestName seconds` per line; `#` comments and blanks ignored. A name with no
# entry weighs 1, so this file steers BALANCE only: scripts/shard-tests
# partitions the live list and cmd/ci-test-workers splits a shard between its
# workers, and every listed name lands in exactly one bucket whatever its
# weight. A stale weight costs an unevenly filled shard, nothing more.
#
# The lane's tests are mostly sub-second. The TestRunner*ExamplePasses suites
# run a tests/stdlib file under the Go interpreter; the ones whose suite the
# self-host stdtest lane also runs (selfHostStdTestCases) were deleted on
# 2026-10-25, which removed the TLS, QUIC, compression and public-key suites
# that took minutes each. Every remaining suite at 10 s or more is listed.
# Measured 2026-10-18 on the 4-core dev container; the CI runner reads lower,
# and the ratio between rows is what the partition uses.
TestRunnerAnsiExamplePasses 13
TestRunnerBenchExamplePasses 15
TestRunnerCoreutilsLongDoubleExamplePasses 84
TestRunnerCoreutilsResolvExamplePasses 11
TestRunnerFormatDurationParseExamplePasses 11
TestRunnerNdarrayExamplePasses 11
TestRunnerPegExamplePasses 10
TestRunnerRegexExamplePasses 11
TestRunnerSetExamplePasses 12
TestRunnerSimFetchExamplePasses 11
TestRunnerStringSnapHelpersExamplePasses 10
TestRunnerTableExamplePasses 13
TestRunnerTextwrapExamplePasses 11
TestRunnerU32ExamplePasses 18
TestRunnerUintRangeExamplePasses 17
